title: cannabis sativa var. ruderalis
intro: Cannabis sativa var. ruderalis, commonly known as 'Ruderalis', is a subspecies of the cannabis plant that is native to Russia and Eastern Europe. This hardy, annual plant is known for its high resistance to cold temperatures and ability to thrive in poor soil conditions, making it an ideal choice for growers in harsh climates. The health benefits of Ruderalis include its potential to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and alleviate symptoms associated with chronic pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Ruderalis include cannabigerol (CBG), cannabidiolic acid (CBDA), and cannabigerolic acid (CBGA), which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and neuroprotective effects.
